# Abarim Publications

> > A comprehensive encyclopedia of Biblical names and their etymologies, exploring Hebrew and Greek linguistic origins as keys to deeper scriptural understanding.

Abarim Publications provides an extensive free online resource for studying Biblical nomenclature across Hebrew, Greek, and Latin traditions. The site combines academic linguistic analysis with philosophical inquiry into how names encode meaning and knowledge within sacred texts.

## Key Topics

- Biblical names
- Hebrew etymology
- Greek etymology
- Name meanings
- Divine names (YHWH, Elohim, Adonai, Shaddai)
- Biblical geography
- Biblical interpretation
- Linguistic analysis
- Ancient Hebrew
- Transliteration and pronunciation
- Biblical reference
- Religious philosophy
- Knowledge systems
- Data compression theory
- Epistemology

## Core Resources

- [Homepage: Why you want to study the Bible, and transcend religion](https://www.abarim-publications.com/index.html): Introduction to Bible study as data compression and cosmic genetic code
- [Biblical Names Encyclopedia](https://www.abarim-publications.com/Meaning/index.html): Main encyclopedia of Hebrew, Greek, and Latin Biblical names with etymological meanings

## Guides & Methodology

- [How were Biblical names pronounced in Biblical times?](https://www.abarim-publications.com/Meaning/Bible_Names.html): Guide to Biblical name pronunciation and ancient Hebrew linguistic practices
- [Translating Biblical names](https://www.abarim-publications.com/Meaning/Translating_Bible_Names.html): Tutorial on the techniques and complexities of translating Biblical names across languages

## Character & Divine Names Reference

- [Male characters in the Bible (alphabetical)](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/A-MaleBig.html): Comprehensive alphabetical reference of male Biblical character names with etymologies
- [Names of God mentioned in the Bible](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/Divine_Names_Bible.html): Reference list of divine names (YHWH, Elohim, Adonai, Shaddai) with meanings and etymologies
- [Names of 'other gods' mentioned in the Bible](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/Other_gods_Bible.html): Reference of pagan and other gods mentioned in Scripture with etymological analysis

## Geographical & Natural Features Reference

- [Rivers and seas mentioned in the Bible](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/Rivers_Bible.html): Reference list of Biblical rivers and seas with meanings and etymological origins
- [Mountains mentioned in the Bible](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/Mountains_Bible.html): Reference of Biblical mountains with etymological meanings and geographical significance

## Specialized Topics Reference

- [Giants in the Bible](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/Giants_Bible.html): Reference of Biblical giants and giant races with etymological analysis for ancient narratives
- [Biblical celestial names](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/2celest.html): Reference of Biblical celestial and constellation-related names with meanings
- [The Bible's musical words and phrases](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/2musicalPhrases.html): Reference of musical terminology and phrases used throughout Biblical texts

## Optional

- [Biblical names that have to do with rain](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/Rain_Names_Bible.html): Reference of Biblical names related to rain and precipitation phenomena
- [Biblical names that have to do with darkness](https://www.abarim-publications.com/NaLi/2darkness.html): Reference of Biblical names related to darkness with etymological analysis
